scope: All 406 registry folder definitions in the pinned v0.1-alpha repository; the released experiment list selects 24. Configuration-derived patterns are provisional and distinct from complete task-formulation review or runnable validation. There are 405 parseable configs with 375 distinct configured IDs, plus one malformed YAML file. The 30 duplicate configured IDs and folder/import mismatches are not independent scientific workflows. No source data, private answers or reference solutions were used. Shared task_defaults and patterns apply to each record; record fields override them. Absent source_task_id means the configured ID equals the folder task_id. Append task_id/config.yaml or task_id/description.md to source_task_root_url for each exact source file.
